Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Access artifacts request for SIG/SOC2 review

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As part of our vendor security review (SIG + SOC2 evidence collection), we need a small bundle of artifacts to verify your access control posture for production systems. Could you please provide the following by EOD Wednesday (May 5) if possible?

- SAML metadata or IdP configuration export for your SSO connection (metadata/XML)
- SCIM provisioning logs that show user create/update events for the last 30 days (CSV preferred)
- RBAC matrix that maps roles to platform permissions (including any service roles)
- A brief least-privilege justification or playbook for how roles are created and reviewed
- Any documentation describing how you enforce scoped access for token- and model-level access (if available)

If some items are sensitive, we can accept redacted copies or a secure share link. Also happy to take a short Zoom to walk through the artifacts.

Best,
Tara Singh
Senior InfoSec Manager
Medisoft Health

Quick update — I pulled the SAML metadata and exported the RBAC matrix (see notes below).

What I attached to this internal message:
- sso-metadata.xml (IdP->SP metadata, redacted cert thumbprint)
- rbac-matrix.xlsx (sheet 1 = high-level roles; sheet 2 = service roles + permissions)

Notes:
- Our RBAC model is hierarchical: Org Admin > Team Admin > Application Maintainer > Read-only. Service roles are scoped to model execution versus infra ops.
- Role provisioning is performed via SCIM (OKTA) and reviewed quarterly during access review windows; emergency role escalations require 2 approvers.
- We do not include PII in the SAML metadata export.

Neha: can you attach the SCIM logs once available and confirm whether we want to include the quarterly review minutes?
